topics.topic: Rogue Planets: The Dark Wanderers of Space
topics.hook: Right now, there are billions of dark, frozen Earth-sized planets drifting through deep space with no sun.
topics.why_watch: Taps into cosmic dread and curiosity about the vast, unseen dangers lurking in interstellar space.

topics.hook: Have you ever learned a new word and suddenly started hearing it everywhere? Your brain isn't glitching—here's why.
topics.why_watch: Instantly relatable everyday psychological phenomenon that triggers an 'aha!' moment and shares easily.

topics.topic: The Biological Immortality of Turritopsis Dohrnii
topics.hook: There is a creature on Earth that can literally reset its age and live forever when it gets sick or old.
topics.why_watch: Defies fundamental human assumptions about life and death using real biology.

topics.hook: In 1901, divers found a rusted gear system in a shipwreck that scientists thought was impossible for its era.
topics.why_watch: Appeals to mystery lovers and history buffs fascinated by advanced ancient engineering.

topics.topic: What If All GPS Satellites Shut Down for 24 Hours?
topics.hook: If GPS went dark for just one day, planes wouldn't just get lost—global banking and power grids would crash.
topics.why_watch: Shocking realization of how invisibly dependent modern infrastructure is on atomic clocks in orbit.

topics.topic: The 'Call of the Void' (L'appel du Vide)
topics.hook: Have you ever stood on a high balcony and had a sudden, terrifying urge to jump? You aren't suicidal.
topics.why_watch: Validates a secret, frightening impulse millions experience but rarely speak about.

topics.topic: The Boomerang Nebula: Colder Than Space Itself
topics.hook: The coldest natural place in the entire known universe is actually colder than empty space itself.
topics.why_watch: Counter-intuitive physics fact that breaks general intuition about cosmic temperatures.

topics.topic: The Mpemba Effect: Hot Water Freezing Faster Than Cold
topics.hook: Pour boiling water into the freezer next to cold water, and the boiling water can freeze first. Physics still argues why.
topics.why_watch: Simple, household-relatable paradox with unresolved scientific discussion that invites comments and debates.

topics.hook: In 1986, an entire African village went to sleep, and over 1,700 people suffocated overnight without a single sound or fire.
topics.why_watch: Bizarre, haunting natural disaster narrative driven by an invisible limnic gas release.

topics.topic: The Demon Core: The Split-Second Mistake
topics.hook: A single flathead screwdriver slip in 1946 triggered a blinding blue flash that doomed a physicist instantly.
topics.why_watch: High-tension true science story emphasizing extreme stakes and instantaneous human error.
